question: How will the frequency of oscillations in an ideal LC circuit change if the capacitance is made four times its initial value, keeping inductance unchanged? Justify your answer.

options.B: $f'=4f$, because frequency is directly proportional to capacitance.
options.C: $f'=\dfrac{f}{4}$, because frequency is inversely proportional to capacitance.
